tasks.short: Schedule patient appointments and coordinate therapist schedules.

steps.what: Capture the patient's identity, contact preferences, availability and therapist-authorized appointment type
Find compatible therapist, room and equipment availability using the practice scheduler
inputs: maintained therapist calendars and booking rules

steps.what: Coordinate therapists' schedules and agree the appointment option with the patient, escalating exceptions to the therapist
outputs: agreed appointment option or unresolved exception

steps.what: Prepare the exact appointment entry and minimal patient confirmation from the agreed option
inputs: agreed appointment option or unresolved exception

steps.what: Approve the final patient, therapist, appointment time, contact destination and confirmation text
Commit the approved patient appointment to the practice and therapist schedules
Send the approved confirmation after successful booking to the named patient contact

tasks.design: Configure native availability filters, appointment types and confirmation fields in {OTHER}, the therapy practice management system, linked to {CALENDAR}. The aide still captures requests and negotiates exceptions, then approves the complete booking and message before separate commitment and patient send actions. Expired availability blocks commitment; changed times, recipients or text require renewed approval, and clinical scheduling changes return to the therapist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual calendar comparison and repeated entry of appointment details.
tasks.enabler_now: Native practice scheduling and confirmations can cover routine booking without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Patient constraints and clinical priority exceptions require people.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when booking is a clinical question rather than an administrative choice.

ambition.what: Coordinate current appointments with less repeated entry.

tasks.altitude: The aide retains booking responsibility and escalates clinical exceptions.

reach.learn: Keep appointment durations and availability authoritative.

evidence.claim: Intramed practice software supports appointment confirmations and reminders to patients; this supports the confirmation mechanism, not a measured saving.

assumptions: The aide captures patient ID, contact destination, availability and authorized appointment type in s1. Therapists maintain their normal availability and appointment-duration rules; missing instructions are clarified in s3.
No self-service work is shifted to patients. Existing conversation effort remains full.
Only routine authorized bookings proceed; this design does not assign clinical priority.
unknowns: Existing native scheduler use and template quality.
research_questions: Which manual calendar comparisons remain after native setup?

already_counted.description: Booking context capture and final patient/time/contact review.

incremental.description: Check booking rules, contact templates and failed confirmations.

approvals.approved_version: approved appointment package version including patient, therapist, time and calendar targets
approved appointment package version including exact confirmation text and patient contact

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: fifteen slot-search, five package preparation and five actual confirmation-send hours saved less two upkeep. Low: native scheduling removes most new benefit. Same-practice scheduling commitment retains full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record treatment actually given and equipment actually used.

steps.what: Confirm patient identity, encounter and the aide's delegated documentation scope
Capture treatment actually given, equipment used and actual deviations using native encounter fields
inputs: actual performed care and equipment observations
outputs: captured actual treatment and equipment facts

steps.what: Prepare the treatment and equipment record using captured facts and native patient/encounter field reuse
inputs: captured actual treatment and equipment facts

steps.what: Verify every treatment and equipment field against actual observations and correct the final draft
inputs: captured actual treatment and equipment facts

steps.what: Review and approve the complete final treatment record under the supervising therapist's responsibility
Commit the approved treatment and equipment record to the patient's clinical dossier

tasks.design: Configure actual-treatment fields, equipment selections and encounter reuse in {OTHER}, the therapy clinical record system. The aide enters observed facts, never copies planned care as proof of delivered care, then checks the assembled record; the supervising therapist approves the complete final version before a separate dossier commit. Missing facts remain explicit, any revision cancels approval, and native structured entry is tested before transcription or custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual care details and encounter identifiers are entered repeatedly in notes.
tasks.enabler_now: Native structured fields and encounter metadata can reduce repeated typing without recording audio.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguish what happened from what was ordered and document deviations accurately.
tasks.human_edge: Report actual observations within delegation and seek therapist clarification.

ambition.what: Record current care accurately with less repetition.

tasks.altitude: The aide remains a supervised recorder, with no clinical decision rights gained.

reach.learn: Review actual care facts and unresolved deviations before commitment.

evidence.claim: Clinical record templates can reuse encounter identifiers and structured equipment fields; their local workflow and permissions require confirmation.

assumptions: Provisional shares total 100 including 15 therapist hours. Aide denominator is 85; no therapist saving is claimed.
s2 produces patient-linked actual intervention, equipment identifier, time and deviations; unlisted equipment and missing details are entered manually there.
Native structured entry saves selection/retyping only; it does not reduce observation or final review.
The supervising therapist review is counted outside the focal denominator and remains full.
unknowns: Current aide record permissions and supervision workflow.
research_questions: Do native actual-care fields reduce repeat entry without encouraging copied planned care?

already_counted.description: Supervising therapist reviews the final record.

incremental.description: Maintain actual-care field choices and check template errors.

approvals.approved_version: therapist-approved treatment record version including actual care, equipment and patient encounter

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: seventeen actual treatment-entry shares saved from85 aide shares gives twenty gross points less two upkeep. Low: native entry already avoids nearly all retyping. Same-clinical-dossier commitment and therapist review retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Measure delegated patient motion, body parts and vital signs.

steps.what: Retrieve the therapist's delegated measurement instructions and confirm patient and measurement site
Measure patient's range-of-joint motion, body parts or vital signs as delegated, repeating suspect readings and observing patient tolerance
outputs: actual measurement readings and observed limitations

steps.what: Capture actual values, units, side, measurement conditions and time in the native observation form
inputs: actual measurement readings and observed limitations

steps.what: Check and approve the final observation entry against actual readings and correct patient context
inputs: actual measurement readings and observed limitations

steps.what: Commit the approved raw measurement observation to the therapist's internal observation worklist
Verbally hand observed readings, limitations and urgent concerns to the supervising therapist for evaluation
inputs: actual measurement readings and observed limitations

tasks.design: Configure a patient-linked delegated measurement view and native observation fields in {OTHER}, the therapy clinical record system. The aide still performs every measurement, enters actual values and checks the final entry before a separate internal raw-observation commit; direct therapist handover remains human. Changed values void approval, urgent concerns are handed over immediately rather than waiting for filing, and the tool neither evaluates treatment effects nor changes care.
tasks.previous_blocker: Measurement instructions and observation fields require repeated navigation and identifier entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native encounter views and observation templates can reduce lookup and recopying.
tasks.still_hard: Reliable positioning, instrument use and patient tolerance.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize an unreliable reading or a patient needing immediate therapist attention.

ambition.what: Reduce documentation repetition around delegated measurements.

tasks.altitude: Hands-on measurement and supervision remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Use actual readings with measurement conditions and limitations.

evidence.claim: Clinical observation templates can reuse patient context while retaining manual actual-value capture.

assumptions: Shares are provisional, not measured; no physical measurement time is reduced.
Therapists produce measurement instructions in normal delegation. s1 includes checking unclear instructions; s3 captures value, units, side, time, conditions and limitations manually.
The aide is allowed to enter raw observations in an internal worklist; therapist interpretation and clinical sign-off remain separate clinical work.
No connected instrument interface or clean digital reading is assumed.
unknowns: Whether the native record has an aide observation worklist.
research_questions: Can a configured view remove navigation without reducing measurement checks?

already_counted.description: Actual-value capture and final observation check.

incremental.description: Check observation field units and delegated-view configuration.

approvals.approved_version: approved aide observation version including actual values, units, conditions and patient encounter

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: three reference lookup and three repeat-entry hours saved less one upkeep. Low: native views remove most new benefit. Same-observation-worklist commitment and actual measurement retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train patients in prescribed supportive device use.

steps.what: Retrieve the therapist's prescribed device instructions and approved device-specific teaching guide
Train patients to use orthopedic braces, prostheses or supportive devices through delegated hands-on demonstration
Observe patient practice, repeat teaching and identify difficulty or tolerance concerns for the therapist
Write the actual training response and concerns in the aide's device-training note
Approve the final training observation note and correct patient encounter
Commit the approved training observation to the therapist's internal aide worklist
Verbally hand learning difficulties or tolerance concerns to the supervising therapist

tasks.design: Configure a device-specific approved-guide view in {DOCS} linked to the patient's delegated instruction in {OTHER}, the therapy clinical record system. Demonstration, practice, observation and the actual response note remain human; only guide navigation and a separately approved internal observation commit change. New concerns go directly to the therapist, changes void note approval, and no model changes device fitting or treatment instructions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the correct guide and filing the completed observation involve small repeated administrative steps.
tasks.enabler_now: Native guide links and aide observation worklists can reduce those steps.
tasks.still_hard: Patient confidence, safe practice and recognizing difficulty with the actual device.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt explanation within delegation and bring concerns to the therapist.

ambition.what: Support the same supervised training with quicker reference access.

tasks.altitude: Hands-on patient training remains the main work.

reach.learn: Use actual practice observations and concerns rather than assumed competence.

evidence.claim: Clinical document links and native observation worklists can support guide retrieval and reviewed internal filing.

assumptions: Shares are provisional, not measured. Physical teaching and patient practice retain full time.

The therapist supplies the prescribed device identifier and delegated instruction; s1 includes checking unclear instructions. The aide captures actual response and concerns in s4, without a prewritten structured input.
The worklist accepts raw aide observations; clinical evaluation and final therapist dossier sign-off are not automated.
This note records learning response, distinct from the general treatment/equipment record. A team roll-up must allocate any locally combined note once.
unknowns: Whether existing record navigation already links the exact approved guide.
research_questions: Does native guide linking remove any meaningful navigation work?

already_counted.description: Actual response note and final observation check.

incremental.description: Check prescribed-device guide links after document revision.

approvals.approved_version: approved device-training note version including actual learning response and patient encounter

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: two device-guide lookup hours saved less half an upkeep hour. Low: native links remove most new benefit. Same-aide-worklist commitment and hands-on instruction retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Therapists retain treatment and evaluation responsibility and receive actual observations.
